tasks.short: Serve on actual academic or administrative committees and write assigned records.

steps.what: Read actual committee papers and assess geography teaching and institutional implications
inputs: actual committee papers supplied by committee secretary

steps.what: Serve on committees through actual deliberation and capture assigned decisions and dissent
inputs: teacher's considered committee issues
actual committee discussion
outputs: teacher-captured decisions, dissent and assigned actions

steps.what: Write assigned committee follow-up from actual captured decisions and dissent
inputs: teacher-captured decisions, dissent and assigned actions

loop.purpose: Restate actual assigned committee follow-up from teacher notes
loop.input: teacher-captured decisions, dissent and assigned actions
loop.output: proposed internal follow-up preserving actual agreement and uncertainty
loop.check: Teacher checks each decision, dissent, owner and omission against actual notes and rejects inferred agreement
loop.stop: Missing decision evidence or two failed revisions returns writing to manual
loop.why_not_simpler: Use fixed action-record headings first; variable explanations of decisions need the bounded prose check

steps.what: Check actual committee meaning and save the ordinary internal assigned follow-up
inputs: proposed assigned committee follow-up
teacher-captured decisions, dissent and assigned actions

tasks.design: Use a fixed follow-up structure and bounded restatement only for committee writing actually assigned to this teacher. Retain reading, committee deliberation, fresh note capture, the complete meaning check and ordinary internal save; no committee agreement or external message is generated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Restating captured committee decisions can repeat actual assigned writing work.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded draft can restate existing notes while the member checks agreement and dissent.
tasks.still_hard: Institutional tradeoffs and actual consensus remain human.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguish a tentative suggestion from a committee decision.
tasks.altitude: Retain committee judgement and check faithful assigned follow-up.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: bounded prose restatement can support actual committee notes but agreement and dissent require a participant's meaning check.

assumptions: Shares15/60/20/5 are provisional, not measured. The member actually owns this follow-up; remove/reweight s3/s4 if the secretary alone writes it. Fresh capture remains s2, not a free transcript.

Only4 restatement points disappear in s3; substantive revision remains16. Full check5 and ordinary save are retained, ungated. Committee papers are existing secretary outputs, not newly generated inputs.
unknowns: Which actual follow-up is assigned to this member?
research_questions: Compare assigned follow-up with source notes for misrepresented dissent.

incremental.description: Maintain follow-up constraints and review recurrent meaning failures.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes4 restatement points less0.7 upkeep. Low: contested institutional policy needs manual wording of disagreement, leaving1 point of uncontested action restatement removable, less0.7 upkeep. Reading15, committee work60 and complete check5 remain.

tasks.short: Advise actual geography students on curricula and careers.

steps.what: Discuss the student's actual academic goals, vocational interests and practical constraints
inputs: actual student and their questions

steps.what: Check current geography prerequisites, fieldwork routes and career references relevant to the student
inputs: understood student aims and constraints
current curriculum and careers references maintained by institution
outputs: checked relevant curriculum and career sources

steps.what: Advise the student on suitable actual study and career options and capture next steps
inputs: understood student aims and constraints
checked relevant curriculum and career sources
outputs: actual advice and next steps captured by teacher

steps.what: Write the actual assigned factual advising note in the internal student record
inputs: actual advice and next steps captured by teacher

tasks.design: Configure a current native reference view for geography prerequisites, fieldwork routes and institutional career sources. Reduce repeated navigation only; retain understanding the student, source applicability, personal advice, fresh capture and actual assigned notes.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated curriculum/reference navigation can interrupt individualized advice.
tasks.enabler_now: Native course and reference links can expose the existing sources directly.
tasks.still_hard: Appropriate advice depends on actual goals and constraints.
tasks.human_edge: Help a student balance an attractive fieldwork route with practical constraints.
tasks.altitude: Use current sources while retaining personal advising.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native reference views can reduce navigation without determining suitable academic or career advice.

assumptions: Shares30/15/45/10 are provisional, not measured. Only3 repeated-navigation points disappear in s2; source reading and applicability remain12. Fresh advice capture is s3 and actual assigned record writing/check/save s4.

If the teacher owns no advising note, remove/reweight that work rather than invent a record. No free transcript, student ranking or automatic recommendation is proposed; ordinary author saves remain ungated.
unknowns: Which current fieldwork and career sources are already directly accessible?
research_questions: Observe source navigation separately from actual student discussion.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes3 navigation points less0.5 upkeep. Low: an international fieldwork/career route needs fresh source research, leaving0.9 familiar course-navigation points removable, less0.5 upkeep. Actual student discussion75 and assigned note10 remain.

tasks.altitude: Check faithful follow-up while retaining collegial reasoning.

tasks.short: Perform actual spatial analysis and modeling using GIS techniques.

steps.what: Verify actual spatial datasets, metadata, coordinate systems, lineage and missing or incompatible layers
inputs: actual spatial datasets and metadata supplied by data custodians or collected in research
actual research question
outputs: verified spatial sources with compatibility and uncertainty notes

steps.what: Choose appropriate spatial analysis and modeling methods and specify their actual parameters
inputs: verified spatial sources with compatibility and uncertainty notes
actual research question
outputs: human-specified spatial processing recipe and parameters

steps.what: Repeat specified per-layer joins, tool selections and intermediate exports across compatible spatial inputs
inputs: human-specified spatial processing recipe and parameters
verified spatial sources with compatibility and uncertainty notes
outputs: spatial processing outputs with source and parameter manifest

steps.what: Interpret actual spatial model results and test their meaning, sensitivity and methodological limitations
inputs: spatial processing outputs with source and parameter manifest
human-specified spatial processing recipe and parameters
verified spatial sources with compatibility and uncertainty notes

steps.what: Write actual analysis conclusions and map limitations in the internal research record
inputs: human-validated spatial interpretation and limitations

tasks.design: Use the GIS application's deterministic batch/model builder for an explicitly human-selected processing recipe, replacing actual repeated per-layer joins, selections and intermediate exports. Retain source and metadata checking, method choice, spatial interpretation, sensitivity checks and authored conclusions; stop incompatible layers for manual handling.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual repeated per-layer screen operations can interrupt a defined spatial-processing recipe.
tasks.enabler_now: Native GIS batch/model builders can apply the same specified recipe across compatible inputs.
tasks.still_hard: Spatial assumptions, source compatibility and meaningful interpretation remain scientific judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize a spatial pattern caused by input resolution or boundaries rather than the phenomenon studied.
tasks.altitude: Specify and validate reproducible spatial processing rather than repeat individual layer operations.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: GIS batch/model builders can repeat explicit joins and processing recipes across compatible layers while method selection and interpretation remain human.

assumptions: OTHER is the actual GIS application. Shares30/25/20/20/5 are provisional, not measured. s3 is only actual focal manual per-layer selections/exports and joins repeated today; existing algorithm runtime or an existing batch pipeline receives no saving.

Upstream spatial collection is existing research or custodian work, not newly free capture. s1 counts actual source/metadata verification and incompatibility work. This design does not choose model methods, infer missing geometry, publish a map or commit an official planning decision; ordinary internal saves in s5 remain retained and ungated.
unknowns: How many compatible layer operations are actually repeated manually?
research_questions: Reproduce a real spatial workflow and compare batch output meaning and metadata with the current manual route.

incremental.description: Maintain actual spatial recipes and test source/parameter manifests when input schemas change.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes20 actual repeated layer-interaction points less1.5 recipe upkeep. Low: incompatible coordinate metadata and changing layer schemas require manual preparation and exports for most inputs, leaving5 points of unchanged compatible-layer repetition removable, less1.5 upkeep. Source checks30, method choice25, interpretation20 and authored conclusions5 remain.
